name: Vim keys and link hints
description: qutebrowser-style keys on web pages: f shows a letter on every link to follow it from the keyboard (F opens it in a new tab), j/k/h/l scroll, gg and G jump to the top and bottom, H/L go back and forward, J/K switch tabs, d closes the tab, u brings it back, r reloads and o opens the command bar. Keys typed into text boxes are left alone.

settings.label: Letters used for link hints
settings.hint: The first ones are used most. Home row letters are easiest to reach.
